result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations: a double-series ansatz $v=\sum a_n^m z^{-3n-1+4m}\alpha^{-n}$ for a second-order differential equation, the resulting recursion for the coefficients $a_n^m$, an Euler–Maclaurin-type representation of $\Pi(s-1)\zeta(s)$ on $s=ti+\tfrac12$, and an integral transform $u$ satisfying a fourth-order partial differential equation.
result.transcription:
[-$a_n=\frac{\alpha}{\pi i}a_{n+1}+\frac{(3n+2)(3n+4)a_{n+3}}{16(\pi i)^2}$-]
$a_{3n-4}=a_{3n-1}\frac{3n-1.3n-2}{16[-\pi i-]\pi i}$
$\frac{1}{8\pi i}\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial z^2}-v(2\pi i zz+2z\alpha)=$
$v=\sum a_n^m z^{-3n-1+4m}\alpha^{-n}$
$\sum a_n^m\frac{1}{16\pi i}(3n+1-4m)(3n+2-4m)z^{-3n-3+4m}\alpha^{-n-1}$ [-...-] $\pi\sum a_n^m z^{-3n+1+4m}$ [-...-] [-...-] $\sum a_n^m z^{-3n+4m}\alpha^{-n}$
$a_{n-1}^m\frac{1}{16\pi i}(3n-2-4m)(3n-1-4m)-\pi i\,a_{n-1}^{m-1}-a_n^m=0,\ 3n>4m$
$\Pi(s-1)\zeta(s)=\Pi(s-1)\sum_1^m\frac{1}{n^s}+\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{-mx}}{e^x-1}x^{s-1}\partial x\qquad s=ti+\frac12$
$\int v\,f(s+z)\,\partial z=2\pi i\sum a_n^m\alpha^{-n}\frac{f^{3n-4m}(s)}{(3n-4m)!}t^{3n-4m}=u$
$f^\nu(s)\frac{z^\nu}{\nu!}$
[-$a_{n-1}^m f^{3n+3-4m}$-] $a$
$a_{n-1}^m f^{3n+3-4m}\alpha^{-n+1}$
$a_{n-1}^{m-1}f^{3n+1-4m}$
$a_n^m f^{3n-4m}$
$\frac{\partial^4 u}{\partial s^4}=\sum a_{n-1}^m\alpha^{-n+1}\frac{t^{3n-3-4m}}{(3n-3-4m)!}f^{3n+1-4m}(3n-2-4m)(3n-1-4m)$
$u=\sum a_{n-1}^{m-1}\alpha^{-n+1}\frac{t^{3n+1-4m}}{(3n+1-4m)!}f^{3n+1-4m}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial s}=\sum a_n^m\alpha^{-n}\frac{t^{3n-4m}}{(3n-4m)!}f^{3n+1-4m}$
$\frac{1}{16\pi i}\frac{\partial^4 u}{\partial s^4}tt-\pi i\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2}-\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial s\partial t}=0$

methods.what: Coefficient recursion for a power-series solution (cancelled version and corrected version)
Second-order ODE in z with parameter alpha
Double series ansatz for the solution v
Recursion for double-indexed coefficients obtained by substituting the ansatz
Representation of Pi(s-1)zeta(s) as partial sum plus integral remainder, on the critical line
Integral transform of f(s+z) with kernel v expressed as a series in derivatives of f (Taylor expansion)
Fourth-order PDE satisfied by u, derived from the coefficient recursion
methods.quote: $\frac{1}{16\pi i}\frac{\partial^4 u}{\partial s^4}tt-\pi i\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2}-\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial s\partial t}=0$
